title: Devops

Quem somos nós? Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que :

Contratação : CLT

Modelo de Trabalho : Remoto

Horário : das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.

Etapas do Processo : Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.

Meios de Comunicação : Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um / uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Seu dia-a-dia será dinâmico e desafiador, com atividades que envolvem desde o desenvolvimento de pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas, até a manutenção de infraestrutura cloud. Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em empresas de grande porte, auxiliando a equipe a alcançar resultados mais rápidos e eficientes através da adoção de metodologias ágeis e da automação de processos. Incluindo atividades como :

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes de infraestrutura cloud;
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou Azure Resource Manager;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI / CD, automatizando processos de integração e entrega contínuas;
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras e de configuração;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua no processo de entrega de software e implementação de otimizações;
  • Resolver incidentes e problemas de produção de maneira rápida e eficaz, garantindo a estabilidade dos sistemas;

Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e comunicar-se efetivamente com outras áreas da empresa.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar :

  • Experiência com plataformas de orquestração de containers, como Kubernetes, Docker Swarm ou Openshift;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de configuração, como Ansible, Puppet e Chef;
  • Experiência em linguagens de programação, como Python, Ruby ou Go, para automatizar tarefas e desenvolver pipelines de CI / CD;
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e metodologias ágeis;
  • Familiaridade com infraestruturas cloud, como AWS, Azure ou GCP;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Observabilidade) e gerenciamento de LOGs, como Datadog, NewRelic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana e Elasticsearch;
  • Experiência com a prática de infraestrutura como código, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation e / ou Azure Resource Manager para provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura cloud.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA / VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;

  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;

Seguro de vida.

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

  • Diagnóstico e plano de ação para maturidade DevOps : mapear processos, ferramentas e práticas atuais, identificando gargalos e propondo um plano de evolução com prioridades claras para eficiência, automação e confiabilidade;

Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de performance e disponibilidade em sistemas distribuídos.

  • Domínio de ferramentas de CI / CD e automação (Jenkins, GitLab, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, ArgoCD, etc.);
  • Vivência em infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares);

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Staff Application Security Engineer role at LEDN

Staff Application Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security:

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito‑based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave‑based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will:
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.

As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

No agencies or recruiters please.

We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Design Director
description:
About Us

Stio® is an omni-channel mountain brand that designs, develops and sells beautiful, functional, and innovative apparel, footwear and other accessories infused with the soul of the mountain lifestyle. With headquarters in Jackson, Wyoming, Stio draws inspiration from the surrounding Teton Range and offers product via Stio.com, catalog, B2B and its Mountain Studio® retail locations.

We live and love mountain life, and as such see ourselves as caretakers of the resources that provide it. We are proud partners of Protect Our Winters and the Conservation Alliance among many other organizations. We have a strong preferred materials platform, use Bluesign® approved textiles wherever possible, audit our supply chains for best practices, and operate our workplaces responsibly.

We think that outside is the best side and that you can’t improve on nature. It’s good for mind, body and soul, and it’s our responsibility to help enable access for all people, regardless of race, gender, beliefs, background or ability. We strive for inclusion at Stio and in our local and national communities.

Your Role

The Stio Design Director is an ambitious and experienced leader responsible for shaping the creative vision and leading the design strategy for all product categories including outerwear, sportswear, footwear, logowear, equipment, and accessories. This role requires a proactive, engaged leader who can define, champion and shepherd the creative vision from initial concept to final product to the customer experience ensuring cohesive, authentic and impactful product experience across all channels. By using design thinking you will apply a deep understanding of the customer and lead a product creation cycle that delivers goods that are user-centered, solution oriented and suited for the totality of the active mountain lifestyle.

As a key member of the product leadership team, you will be connected to the long range product vision as well as the business drivers. You will work closely with the leadership team to manage the seasonal timeline, integrate design’s vision in the Go To Market cycle, bring design to life through the creation team and influence business outcomes with clear, effective communication.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design Vision and Influence
    • Define and execute long-term design strategies across categories, leading the business with innovative trend research, color, print, and pattern development
    • Build and present concept, trend and seasonal GTM resources as needed to provide creative input and direction for all downstream GTM and customer experience activations such as photoshoots, styling, and overall visual presentation of the product
    • Lead Stio's seasonal color vision across all categories applying trend research and Stio color identity, directing visual evidence collection, and overseeing surface design execution including prints and yarn dye patterns to ensure a consistent, inspiring brand language
    • Maintain and evolve Stio's Design DNA, logo guidelines, construction standards, and color processes to ensure cohesive execution across categories
    • Act as the voice of the future unmet customer needs championing and advocating for the creative team's vision and necessary resources in high-level discussions
  • Product & Material Strategy
    • Lead the design creation process from concept to product approval, ensuring our mission of creating inspired, elevated, functional design is consistently executed
    • Lead innovation using the advanced development pipeline, creating concepts and validating construction challenges ahead of GTM commercialization to validate solutions prior to adoption into the seasonal line plan
    • Collaborate with Materials Managers to plan and direct all fabric and materials that align with seasonal merchandising and design intent
  • Team Leadership & Resourcing
    • Inspire, manage and mentor a team of designers, color/pattern specialists, and contractors, fostering innovation, collaboration, and executional excellence
    • Champion product design vision within the Stio strategy group, including senior leadership, to share and execute long range plan
    • Oversee design team workload and resource planning, manage external design partners, and be responsible for key areas of budget

Your Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in creative design or related field
  • 10+ years professional design experience in apparel/product development
  • 5+ years Creative/Design Director management experience
  • Management experience with 4+ direct reports
  • Proven experience bringing performance product to market across multiple categories
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
  • Experience with 3D design (Vstitcher preferred)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and PLM systems
  • Strong fashion illustration and technical drawing capabilities
  • Expertise in pattern development, mock-ups, and prototype creation
  • Advanced understanding of fabric performance, garment construction, and textiles
  • Commitment to our company mission, vision, and values
  • Ability to travel up to 20% (domestic and international) to support business initiatives

The Fine Print

  • Must be able to work in a sedentary position, move around the office, and occasionally move objects or boxes 15+ lbs
  • This role can be remotely located anywhere within the continental US.
  • Medical, Dental Vision plans
  • Company Paid Long Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k with Match
  • Flexible paid time off policies
  • Gear stipend, Company perks, and more

We provide competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives and benefits. The base salary range for this role is $100,000-$130,000. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of the range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors including experience, skills, and qualifications.

description:
Overview

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Cultura Organizacional

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Windows Server (avançado), Linux (diferencial);
  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Cloud Computing: AWS, Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS) e Microsoft 365;
  • Redes: TCP/IP, roteamento, switching, WiFi, VPNs, Firewalls;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

Additional information

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto (home office), com necessidade de deslocamento para nossa sede em Barretos/SP em média 4 vezes ao ano para alinhamentos e eventos de equipe.

title: Strategic Pursuit Lead
description:
Our Company
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.
We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

Role Purpose

The Strategic Pursuit Leader (SPL) is the transformation architect and executive deal leader responsible for driving Adobe’s largest and most strategic enterprise pursuits (>$10M). SPLs sit at the intersection of sales excellence, transformation leadership, and executive storytelling – orchestrating Adobe’s full ecosystem, including partners and consulting firms, to deliver measurable business outcomes for customers.

SPLs are expected to operate as Adobe’s elite transformation sellers – the best salespeople, transformation leaders, and storytellers in the company – defining how Adobe sells enterprise transformation in an AI-first, partner-enabled world.

Mission

To lead a repeatable, scalable, and disciplined pursuit program that drives Adobe’s long-term revenue growth and customer transformation through AI-enabled, partner-aligned, cross-cloud solutions – acting as the single source of truth and accountability for all strategic pursuits in the $10M+ deal band.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Transformation, Not Transactions:
    1. Serve as the executive strategist and deal owner for enterprise-scale pursuits. Partner with customer executives to define a North Star transformation vision that connects business outcomes, AI strategy, and Adobe’s capabilities. Translate complex enterprise change into measurable business impact.
  • Command the Pursuit Business:
    1. Own the qualification, strategy, and execution of each $10M+ pursuit. Drive forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and deal velocity with precision and urgency. Lead pursuit planning and orchestration across Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, Professional Services, and Partners.
  • Orchestrate the Ecosystem:
    1. Mobilize Adobe’s internal and external ecosystem – including Deal Desk, Legal, Product, Consulting, Partners, GSIs, and agencies – to deliver unified pursuit execution. Build trusted relationships with consulting firms and hyperscalers to co-create transformation strategies that scale.
  • Master Storytelling & Executive Engagement:
    1. Craft and deliver C-suite-level transformation narratives that inspire confidence and action. Present Adobe’s AI-first story through compelling storytelling that integrates creativity, data, and intelligence. Be recognized as a thought leader on digital transformation and enterprise value realization.
  • Drive Industry, Partner & AI Expertise:
    1. Maintain deep understanding of assigned industries, partner ecosystems, and AI adoption trends. Leverage customer and partner insights to shape differentiated value narratives. Stay ahead of market evolution through continuous learning and engagement with Adobe’s AI and partner teams.
  • Exhibit Leadership & Enablement Excellence:
    1. Demonstrate consistent participation in the SPL Mastery Curriculum, enablement programs, and cross-functional sessions. Model accountability, preparation, and composure. Lead by example and mentor peers through field shadowing, retrospectives, and co-led pursuits.
  • Contribute to SPL Brand & Thought Leadership:
    1. Represent Adobe’s transformation leadership both internally and externally. Contribute to LinkedIn thought leadership, industry storytelling, and customer transformation showcases. Elevate Adobe’s reputation through professional visibility and partnership engagement.

Required Experience & Attributes

  • 10+ years in enterprise software, SaaS, or consulting with consistent quota attainment on $10M+ opportunities.
  • Proven ability to lead multi-year, multi-stakeholder digital transformation engagements.
  • Executive presence – credible with C-suite leaders across business, IT, and partner ecosystems.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise sales methodology, value-based selling, and outcome-based commercial structures.
  • Strong knowledge of AI trends, partner ecosystems, and consulting firm collaboration models.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills – able to simplify complexity and inspire confidence.
  • Comfortable managing ambiguity, high-stakes negotiations, and accountability across cross-functional and partner teams.
  • Industry specialization or AI solution familiarity preferred (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Technology).

Cultural Anchors

Think Boldly. Operate with Precision. Lead from the Front.

SPLs model accountability, presence, and composure – elevating those around them and redefining what transformation selling looks like at Adobe. They focus where it matters, move with urgency, execute with precision, and lead from the front.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

You work in close collaboration with Talent Partners, delivery leads, and hiring managers to understand hiring challenges, shape sourcing strategies, and deliver measurable impact. As an experienced sourcing professional, you balance execution with advisory—leveraging market insights, data, and creative sourcing methods to solve hiring problems and improve outcomes.

This role is ideal for a curious, data-literate talent acquisition professional looking to deepen their sourcing influence while operating in a fast-paced, global digital consultancy environment.

  • Build talent pipelines and engage with exceptional talent to join Valtech for our Technology, Delivery, and Creative practices

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition

  • Drive to succeed and grow

  • Detail oriented and analytical

  • Ability to work autonomously, adapting quickly to evolving priorities and stakeholder needs
  • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter

Nice to have qualifications

  • A 4-year degree is desired
  • A strong understanding of enterprise IT concepts and emerging technology is desired, but not required
  • Experience with an ATS (we use Greenhouse)

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a full-time, remote position based in Brazil .

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

Description

Cyera is on a mission to protect one of the world's most valuable resources: data. Our AI-native platform gives organizations a complete view of where their data lives, how it’s used, and how to keep it safe, so they can reduce risk and unlock the full value of their data, wherever it is.

Since our founding in 2021, we’ve grown fast- Cyera-fast - securing over $1.3 billion in funding from the biggest pockets on the planet and establishing a global team. Today, Cyera is the fastest growing data security company on the planet, trusted by the Fortune 500 and beyond.

About the Team

The Brand & Creative team shapes Cyera’s visual voice across campaigns, product narratives, and go-to-market initiatives. Our work turns complex stories into clear, compelling assets that drive awareness, influence pipeline, and strengthen the brand. This team values clarity, craft, and operational excellence. The Program Manager is the connective tissue that keeps work flowing with speed and quality, aligning designers and stakeholders around crisp plans, expectations, and outcomes.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Program Manager to lead Design Operations end-to-end—from brief to delivery. In this role, you’ll run the operating cadence for a global creative team, own the intake and prioritization process, and coordinate closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Design. You’ll bring structure to creative work without stifling it: clear briefs, transparent timelines, measurable KPIs, and smooth handoffs. Your work ensures the right projects ship on time, to spec, and with real business impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Orchestrate day-to-day workflows across the design studio; balance capacity, run weekly planning, and keep the roadmap current.
  • Own the Creative board in Asana: triage requests, clarify briefs, define priorities and due dates, and track status through delivery.
  • Partner with global stakeholders (primarily U.S.) in Marketing, Growth, Sales, and Product to turn business needs into actionable creative plans and timelines.
  • Establish operating cadences—intake, kickoffs, reviews, approvals, retrospectives—and codify SLAs from brief to handoff.
  • Lead vendor operations: NDAs, onboarding, scopes, content coordination, deliverables tracking, and invoice alignment to budget.
  • Define and track KPIs for design projects (throughput, cycle time, on-time delivery, rework rate, stakeholder satisfaction); publish clear reports.
  • Build internal communication formats and knowledge repositories: weekly updates, quarterly reviews, playbooks, and templates.
  • Support formal planning and optimization: annual and quarterly plans, resource modeling, process-improvement experiments, and post-mortems.
  • Proactively surface risks, remove blockers, and drive crisp, timely communication across time zones.

Requirements

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years in creative operations, PMO, marketing operations, or design program management in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mastery of project management tools (Asana required) and spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets); able to build dashboards and status views.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating global stakeholders and vendors; excellent written and verbal communication in English.
  • Strong process design and change-management skills; can zoom from big picture to detail and back.
  • Ownership mindset: proactive, organized, and unafraid to raise flags early and drive decisions.
  • Flexibility to collaborate with U.S.-based teams and join occasional evening calls.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Notion/Confluence, or similar knowledge-management tools.
  • Hands-on exposure to creative/brand/design workflows; know what a good brief and review cycle looks like.

Why Join Us?

At Cyera, we care about collaboration, innovation, and agility. We take “teamwork” seriously—with our inclusive and supportive culture at the forefront—and we’re just as serious about nurturing Cyerans to grow, both personally and professionally.

Feel free to apply even if your experience doesn’t tick every box.

We’re building something special here—and we welcome Cyerans with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Overview

JOB TITLE Product Lead, Slate

LOCATION Worcester

DEPARTMENT NAME Enterprise Cloud Systems

DIVISION NAME Worcester Polytechnic Institute - WPI

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Product Lead, Slate, is responsible for the strategic oversight and continuous improvement of the Slate CRM platform, supporting functions such as admissions, enrollment, communications, and student engagement. This role will report to the Director, Enterprise Cloud Systems. The role leads the full product lifecycle—from ideation and development to deployment and optimization—to ensure the platform aligns with institutional goals and delivers measurable value. In this capacity, the Product Lead may manage a team, including direct reports such as system administrators or analysts who support Slate. They provide leadership, coaching, and performance management to ensure the team delivers secure, scalable, and user-centered solutions. The Product Lead works closely with these team members to align technical execution with product strategy and ensure seamless delivery of enhancements and support. The role requires close collaboration with stakeholders across business and technology domains to define and communicate a clear product vision. The Product Lead plays a key role in shaping the end-to-end user experience and ensuring that Slate evolves to meet the institution’s changing needs.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Product Lead for Slate, managing tenant configuration, security administration, and release planning.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshoot issues related to Slate and other enterprise cloud systems as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with the Graduate Studies team—including Recruiting & Marketing and Admissions—Summer Studies, and University Marketing to ensure system functionality aligns with strategic goals and operational needs.
  • Define and manage the Slate product roadmap, ensuring alignment with institutional goals and user needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, monitor performance, and manage transitions from development to production.
  • Serve as a liaison between business units and technical teams, translating requirements and resolving integration or customization challenges.
  • Coordinate with enterprise architects and data teams to ensure alignment of product and platform strategies.
  • Evaluate and prototype new Slate features and technologies to support innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Lead major system releases, ensuring new functionality meets business and technical requirements.
  • Mentor team members who support Slate operations and development.
  • Ensure the team maintains system performance, security, and compliance standards.
  • Align team activities with product goals, ensuring operational readiness for new features and updates.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems or related field.
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in IT, business, or higher education, with a strong understanding of end-user needs and value drivers.
  • 3+ years in progressively responsible roles across business and/or IT functions. Business-only backgrounds are acceptable if they include significant technology collaboration.
  • Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders in support of strategic initiatives.
  • Experience managing technical teams or direct reports is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (preferably Slate), design thinking principles, and modern software delivery methodologies.
  • Strong communication, time management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Salary: $95,000 (depending on experience)

Benefits: WPI offers a comprehensive package including 4 weeks of paid time off, an additional week at the end of December, 13 paid holidays, health, dental, and vision insurance, a 9.5% retirement match after one year, disability and life insurance, tuition assistance (including full WPI tuition for dependents after 3 years), and free access to the fitness center.

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

Revisar tecnicamente o mapa de conteúdo e o conteúdo bruto (texto), garantindo precisão conceitual e adequação didática. Os temas incluem:

  • Evolução do cavalo e influência no comportamento alimentar;

  • Anatomia e fisiologia do sistema digestivo dos equinos (diferenças em relação a ruminantes, importância do ceco funcional e da dentição);

  • Princípios básicos da nutrição equina: nutrientes, funções, exigências e consequências da deficiência/excesso;

  • Manejo alimentar diário de equinos: horários, quantidades, ajustes por categoria, adaptação e transição de dietas;

  • Monitoramento hídrico e práticas de fornecimento de água (necessidades diárias, fatores de influência, estratégias de fornecimento seguro);

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, but is also passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will design, implement and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About The Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications – Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools – MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints). You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.

  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

ICON plc is a world‑leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Collaborating with medical and clinical teams to assess the clinical relevance of reported adverse events and contribute to risk management activities.
  • Overseeing the maintenance and integrity of pharmacovigilance databases, ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with data management standards.
  • Providing training and mentorship to junior team members on pharmacovigilance processes, regulatory requirements, and best practices.

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Extensive experience in pharmacovigilance or drug safety, with a strong understanding of relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Proven ability to manage the pharmacovigilance process effectively, including adverse event reporting and signal detection.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across cross‑functional teams.
  • Proficiency in pharmacovigilance databases and data management systems, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive patient information with discretion.

Here at Gaia, our employees are the foundation of our success. We believe it's super important that you are happy, healthy, and motivated.

Additionally, we offer all new hires a set up budget in addition to an annual personal development budget to build your skills, knowledge, and potential. We’re working hard on our reward and recognition framework to make sure that those who are excelling above and beyond get what they deserve.

Our vision

Everyone who wants a family should have the chance to try. For the 1 in 6 families that struggle to conceive, fertility treatments are an option but they are expensive. We created the world’s first IVF insurance allowing more people who wish to be parents to pursue treatment with increased financial flexibility. Because the difference between having a child or not should not be how rich you are.

The role

From the very first moment someone considers Gaia as part of their fertility journey, we aim to offer clarity and care. That’s where you come in.

We’re looking for a BDR (Patient Support) to connect with prospects as they consider Gaia for their fertility journey.

You’ll be the first human touchpoint for patients early in their fertility journey; answering questions, building trust, and making sure they feel supported every step of the way.

This is a unique opportunity to support people at one of the most pivotal moments in their lives and help shape how Gaia shows up for them.

  • You’ll work closely with our Marketing team to manage the prospect pipeline for any patient starting their fertility journey in the early stages.
  • You’ll be acting as the main point of contact for prospects and guiding them seamlessly through the initial stages of their journey.
  • You’ll as a point of contact for clinic staff at your assigned clinics to support members book their initial consultations.
  • You’ll book initial calls between “ready to go” patients and our Member Growth Team.

Your responsibilities:

  • Manage a marketing pipeline of Gaia prospects.
  • Qualify potential members at their early stages throughout inbound forms and outbound sales calls.
  • Support MQLs to book a clinic consultation.
  • Book initial calls between Gaia Prospects and Member Growth Associates.
  • Manage all communication with Prospects via calls and email.
  • Effectively carry out processes to track prospects' initial journey and share data with clinics and the rest of the team.
  • Identify opportunities for increasing our sales pipeline to drive overall Member growth.

You’ll be a great candidate for this role if you:

  • Have minimum 1 year of experience qualifying leads and potential prospects over the phone and via inbound forms required .

  • Are empathetic and deeply care about our Members - the IVF experience is incredibly stressful and empathy for what they are going through is a must.
  • Are a self-starter - you’ll be working as part of a small team but also a specific growth project, so we’ll be looking to you to help set us up for success.
  • Have strong interpersonal skills - you’ll constantly be communicating with patients, clinic staff and the rest of our company via email and phone calls.

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you’ll join a mission‑driven, fast‑paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting‑edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking an Accounts Payable Specialist to play a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely payments and building scalable procurement processes at TRM. As a fully remote, global company, TRM requires an AP function that is both efficient and strategic—balancing day‑to‑day execution with process improvements that strengthen vendor relationships, support healthy cash flow, and raise standards for financial discipline.

You will join TRM’s high‑performing Finance team, which leads with ownership, accountability, and a commitment to excellence. Partnering closely with Finance, HR, and cross‑functional teams, you’ll ensure invoices are processed on time, vendors are supported seamlessly, and AP systems evolve to meet the needs of a fast‑growing organization.

The impact you will have:

  • Own payment operations : Consistently achieve >95% on‑time and accurate payments while completing AP close within target timelines to support cash flow visibility.
  • Enhance vendor & employee experience : Manage Zip effectively, onboard vendors quickly, and resolve invoice/payment inquiries while maintaining >90% compliance with card submissions.
  • Streamline procurement : Develop and implement procurement processes, including vendor negotiations, policy rollouts, and measurable cost savings that establish best practices at TRM.
  • Drive system & process improvements : Identify and implement automation or workflow enhancements to reduce manual work, strengthen liability forecasting, and improve scalability.
  • Support month‑end close : Prepare and review accruals, manage prepaid expense amortization, and reconcile accounts payable to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
  • Partner cross‑functionally : Provide timely, accurate AP reporting and collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, HR, and other teams to ensure a seamless procurement and payment experience.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3–5 years of accounts payable experience, ideally in a SaaS, startup, or high‑growth environment.
  • Strong understanding of AP processes and procurement workflows; experience with Zip, Airbase, Netsuite or similar systems is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with a proven track record of processing payments and invoices reliably and on time.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to identify process gaps, reconcile issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who builds trusted relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership mindset, able to manage multiple AP responsibilities simultaneously while driving continuous improvement.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • High‑Priority Requests: For P1 items, able to immediately jump in and resolve employee/vendor requests for urgent, time‑sensitive purchases within the same day, without compromising accuracy.
  • Policy Rollouts: When a new procurement or AP policy is introduced, able to implement the change in systems and workflows within 1 week of rollout.
  • Vendor Invoice Processing & Communication: Upload vendor invoices to the system within 24–48 hours of receipt and respond to vendor email inquiries within 1 business day.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact‑Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high‑impact challenges in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission‑driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone . If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high‑velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you.

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real‑world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote‑first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast‑paced, high‑impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote‑first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description— we value passion, problem‑solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third‑party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Diferenciais

  • Matriz de confusão.
  • Curvas de perda e acurácia durante o treinamento.
  • Distribuição de IoU (Interseção Sobre a União).
  • Learning curves (treino vs. validação).
  • Dados estruturados (como diferencial): Gráficos de resíduos em regressão.
  • Curvas de calibração de probabilidade.
  • Feature importance, SHAP e PDP/ICE plots.
  • Heatmaps de correlação e PCA (scree plot, biplot).
  • MLOps / produção: Gráficos de detecção de drift de dados.
  • Distribuição de probabilidades de saída (overconfidence).
  • Métricas de latência/throughput.
  • Consumo de GPU/CPU/memória em inferência.

Join to apply for the Senior Data Analyst role at Trustly .

WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we’re building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high‑growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.

About the team

The Analytics team leverages data to drive decisions and unlock significant business value. Our mission is to deliver first‑class data products, going beyond traditional reporting.

What you’ll do

  • Data Architecture and Modeling: Design, develop, and maintain scalable and robust data models to support reporting, business intelligence, and data analytics.
  • Data Visualization: Develop and maintain insightful dashboards using Amazon QuickSight.
  • Optimization and Automation: Identify and implement opportunities to improve efficiency, performance, and accuracy of current processes.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders to gather their business requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions.
  • Data Quality and Governance: Establish and enforce best practices for data quality, documentation, and governance.
  • Drive data literacy and adoption: Champion a data‑driven culture within the organization by sharing knowledge, best practices, and promoting the use of data in decision‑making.
  • Data Analysis: Define problem statements, formulate hypotheses, and execute rigorous analysis to uncover key trends, patterns, and opportunities across various business functions.
  • Advanced analytics: Utilize statistical techniques, machine learning concepts, and data mining methodologies to build predictive models, segmentation strategies, and other advanced analytical solutions.

Who you are

  • Proven experience in a similar role: A strong track record in a data‑focused role such as Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or BI Engineer, preferably in fintech.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL: Expertise in SQL is essential for data querying, modeling, and transformation.
  • Experience with data visualization tools: Proficiency in creating insightful and actionable dashboards. Experience with Amazon QuickSight is a plus.
  • Programming: Python/PySpark for data manipulation and pipeline development.
  • Business acumen: Ability to understand business objectives and translate them into analytical questions and solutions.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication and collaboration skills are a must, as you’ll be working with a diverse range of technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Fluent English: You’ll work with a Global team.

Our perks and benefits

  • Bradesco health and dental plan, for you and your dependents, with no co‑payment cost.
  • Life insurance with differentiated coverage.
  • Meal voucher and supermarket voucher.
  • Home Office Allowance.
  • Team Allowance.
  • Wellhub – Platform that gives access to spaces for physical activities and online classes.
  • Trustly Club – Discount at educational institutions and partner stores.
  • English Program – Online group classes with a private teacher.
  • Extended maternity and paternity leave.
  • Birthday Off.
  • Flexible hours/Home Office – our culture is remote‑first! You can work in every city in Brazil.
  • Welcome Kit – We work with Apple equipment (MacBook Pro, iPhone) and we send many treats! Spoiler alert: Equipment can be purchased by you according to internal criteria.
  • Annual premium – As a member of our team, you are eligible to receive an annual bonus, at the company’s discretion, based on the achievement of our KPIs and individual performance.
  • Referral Program – If you refer a candidate and we hire the person, you will receive a reward for that.

Do not forget to submit your resume in English.

Check out our Glassdoor or our Brazil Life page on Linkedin for more details about Brazil, our culture, and much more.

  • Distribuição de IoU (Interseção Sobre a União).
  • Learning curves (treino vs. validação).
  • Dados estruturados (como diferencial): Gráficos de resíduos em regressão.
  • Curvas de calibração de probabilidade.
  • Feature importance, SHAP e PDP/ICE plots.
  • Heatmaps de correlação e PCA (scree plot, biplot).

Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.

Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma

Valores

Responsabilidades e atribuições geral

Profissional sênior com sólida experiência em projetos SAP MM, especialmente em iniciativas de conversão e migração do SAP ECC para o S/4HANA. O foco será na otimização e integração de processos de compras, gestão de materiais e integração com áreas financeiras e logísticas, considerando requisitos específicos da localização Argentina.

Atividades

  • Participe das fases de Exploração, Construção, Testes e Go-Live do projeto SAP S/4HANA.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
If you're into online shopping (who isn't these days?), chances are you've crossed paths with Yotpo. We're all about eCommerce retention—helping brands of every size turn one-time shoppers into lifelong customers.

Think loyalty programs and reviews—it's what we do best. Plus, we've got more tricks up our sleeve.

With teams spread across the globe—from the US and Canada to the UK, Israel, Bulgaria, and Australia—we're growing fast. Our main mission? Delivering cutting-edge technology that sets new standards in the industry.

Sounds exciting? Then read on, because we’re looking for curious professional talents to be a part of building the future of the e-commerce industry.

At Yotpo, we’re on a mission to help brands strengthen relationships with their customers through innovative retention marketing solutions. As part of our Loyalty Product team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our loyalty offering by driving data-informed decisions that directly influence product strategy and customer outcomes. This role is central to Yotpo’s growth and impact, allowing you to partner across product, design, and engineering to deliver real value.

Why Join Us:

  • Opportunity to shape Yotpo’s Loyalty strategy and be a leading voice in the Product Operating model
  • High-impact role with exposure to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • A collaborative, fast-moving team culture focused on growth, innovation, and customer success

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive a culture of data-informed decision-making to maximize product success and growth
  • Act as the main analytical partner for your team and its key stakeholders
  • Conduct in-depth analyses to reveal opportunities and shape the product roadmap
  • Work with large and complex datasets to extract insights and translate them into practical recommendations for product improvementsBuild and manage dashboards and reports to monitor KPIs and communicate findings effectively
  • Partner closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to identify opportunities for product optimization using data-backed insights

Required Skills:

  • At least 5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role
  • Strong command of SQL (mandatory)
  • Excellent storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders
  • Solid grasp of numerical analysis and business acumen: knowing when a simple metric is enough versus when advanced forecasting is required
  • Comfortable handling uncertainty and complex challenges
  • Enthusiastic about understanding user behavior and advocating for user-centric product development
  • Naturally curious, independent, and detail-oriented
  • Proficient in advanced data analysis with large datasets using tools like Python, Pandas, R, and SQL

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with the ecommerce space

If you’re excited about leveraging data to shape the future of loyalty products and want to make an impact in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you. At Yotpo, we’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives drive innovation and growth. Join us and help brands worldwide create stronger, more meaningful customer relationships.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products like our hCaptcha security suite. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.

As a Backend Engineer you will be responsible for work on core production code that can include distributed systems work and implementing or optimizing machine learning paths. You will improve and drive our evolving systems, threat models, and CI/CD practice.

What you will do:

  • Design, build and maintain secure, scalable backend services and algorithms
  • Implement DevSecOps practices: security protocols, monitoring, metrics, and automated alerts
  • Write clean, well-documented, production-quality code with thorough test coverage
  • Strengthen engineering practices through code reviews, testing automation, and on-call support
  • Translate complex requirements into actionable sprint tasks

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in a similar role.
  • Expertise in backend development in Python and at least one of: Golang, Rust, C++.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, metrics-driven deployment, containerization, and microservices.
  • Experience in implementing and using monitoring and tracing solutions.
  • Experience with key-value stores and SQL databases and optimizing their performance.
  • Experience with high traffic, low latency distributed systems: queue-first arch, sharding, etc.
  • Interest in clean architecture (gather requirements, problem solve and recommend).

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Golang, Rust, or C++
  • Experience with high traffic, low latency distributed systems: queue-first architectures, sharding, etc.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript/React and frontend development.
  • Willingness to learn and work across different technologies: Python, Golang, Redis, PostgreSQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Clickhouse, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS, Azure, JavaScript.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks, attack vectors, botnets, OLAP at scale, and online + active learning systems.
  • Experience or interest in AI/ML and blockchain technologies.

What we offer:

  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
  • An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.
  • Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.
  • High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting edge R&D.
  • Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all members of our team. Join us as we transform cyber security, user privacy, and machine learning online!

title: Staff engineer - Feegow (100% remote in Brazil)
description:
Staff Engineer - Feegow (100% remote in Brazil)

Company Description

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia, or Docplanner. The names differ depending on the country, but we are all part of the Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today the next step is to help people live longer and healthier lives.

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health‑tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top‑tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end‑to‑end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high‑quality healthcare.

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300,000+ specialists believe in us and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2,500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup‑mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we’re 100% remote‑friendly.

Hybrid model (RJ): If you live in RJ and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in Santo Cristo/RJ and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).

Hybrid model (CWB): If you live in Curitiba and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in the center of Curitiba and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).

Remote model: you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Staff Engineer to co‑lead our modernization efforts, drive innovation, and play a key role in our product evolution. Your expertise in cloud technologies, legacy system migrations, and microservices will help modernize our architecture and enhance scalability, ensuring the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

Role

As a Staff Engineer in this area, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for leading impactful and complex cross‑group and cross‑area technical initiatives, ensuring high‑quality solutions with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with Engineering Managers and other tech counterparts to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director.

We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to actively contribute to the technical direction of the area.

Our tech stack

Docplanner Tech includes .Net, PHP, and Vue/React, running on Kubernetes in AWS. While expertise in these technologies isn’t required, this is a very technical and hands‑on role, for which strong communication skills and experience influencing technical decisions are also essential to effectively support the teams.

What you will be doing

  • Lead and drive technical initiatives that impact area level directions (~5 teams).
  • Actively partner with your Engineering Manager / Tech lead counterparts and engineering teams, as well as working closely with the leaders of the area/company to develop an effective technical strategy.
  • Provide accountability for all the technical initiatives led.
  • Act as a point of reference for our Engineering teams.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching inside the team.

Qualifications

  • Solid technical background related to the whole SDLC principles and practices (Agile/CD, Lean, SRE, DevOps) and can support and unblock engineering teams in complex technical discussions.
  • Legacy software modernization and migration: proven experience in modernizing and migrating legacy systems to modern architectures.
  • Approach software development with a lean, proactive, and positive mindset, balancing impact and long‑term sustainable development, with a strong accountability for delivering high‑quality solutions.
  • Strong experience in backend development with a holistic understanding of full‑stack systems.
  • Experience in cross‑team initiative and creating buy‑in for technical initiatives.
  • Believe in continuous learning and improvement.
  • Experience not only designing/implementing/delivering high‑quality and impactful solutions, but also guiding and mentoring less experienced engineers.

Additional Relevant

  • Domain‑Driven Design.
  • Expertise in AWS to help shaping our cloud infrastructure.
  • Ability to oversee database optimizations (MySQL) for scalable solutions.
  • Cloud‑native architectures using microservices and serverless along with interaction styles, as synchronous and asynchronous communication, data streaming, and API technologies and lifecycle management.
  • Advanced English skills: comfortable communicating in written and verbal English across global teams.
  • Previous experience in consulting is a plus.

Important

Docplanner is an international English‑first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English.

Benefits

  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • Compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!;
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options - eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period);
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
